notes: Piece counts match the parts list (91 pieces); ids b1..b91 follow booklet step order, with sub-assembly pieces numbered in the order of the step's parts box.

The model is built with the white 4x4 plate (b1) as the bottom of the torso. The legs (step 21-23) hang beneath it: the white 2x2 plate b71 has its studs in b1's underside, the four headlight bricks clutch b71's underside, and the foot plates b80/b81 sit under the headlights. So b1 rests on b71, b71 rests on the headlights, and the headlights rest on the feet. The feet stand on the base plate b91.

Pieces attached on their side (to the side studs of the 22885 bricks or the headlight bricks) are recorded in other_joins, not rests_on. Pieces built flat in a sub-assembly (arm plates with tile and clip plate) use rests_on.

Exact positions of the small head parts (brown front plates and tiles, side/ear/hair plates, back plates) on the head's faces are my best reading of small booklet drawings. The exact stud-to-stud pairings are an assumption. The 22885 head ring is taken as 6 bricks per layer (2 front, 2 back, 1 each side), with the red brick at front right.

Step 24: the white round plate b82 is assumed to go in the cone end with the black round plate. The clip tile b83 is assumed to sit on a stud of the arm clip plate b30 and to hold the gun in its clip.
The step 2 round plates are assumed to be clutched by the 1x1 clip plate b5, with the black ones outside the white ones.
The base in step 25 is read as: b88 and b87 side by side on b91, b89 on b88's studs, and the printed tile b90 on b91.
